slides.texte_overlay:
5 words that will make
you sound more eloquent

Jovial:
cheerful and
friendly
(JOH-vee-uhl)

Example:
Her jovial laugh filled
the little café.

Affable:
easy and pleasant
to talk to
(AF-uh-buhl)

Example:
She was affable with
everyone she met.

Succinct:
clear and brief
(suhk-SINGKT)

Example:
Her answer was succinct
and perfect.

Cordial:
warm and polite
(KAWR-juhl)

Example:
They had a cordial
chat after the concert.

Cogent:
clear, logical
and convincing
(KOH-juhnt)

Example:
She made a cogent case
for reading more history.
